name: Gemalli
title: Father of the spy Ammiel from Dan
summary: Gemalli was a man from the tribe of Dan and father of Ammiel, who was one of the twelve spies Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. He is mentioned only in connection with his son's role as a spy. His name possibly means 'camel owner' or is linked to the Hebrew word for 'camel'.

keyEvents.title: Ammiel Sent as a Spy
keyEvents.description: Gemalli's son Ammiel was chosen as the representative from the tribe of Dan among the twelve spies Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Twelve Spies Are Sent Out
keyEvents.description: Moses sent twelve men, one from each tribe, to explore the promised land. Ammiel, son of Gemalli, was among them.

keyEvents.title: Return and Report of the Spies
keyEvents.description: After forty days, the spies returned with a report about the land of Canaan. Ten of the twelve, likely including Ammiel, gave a negative report that caused fear among the people.

keyEvents.title: The People's Revolt After the Spies' Report
keyEvents.description: The negative report from the majority of the spies led the people of Israel to revolt against Moses and Aaron, refusing to enter the promised land.
